RESOLUTION NO. ________________
A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF ABILENE, TEXAS,
APPROVING THE PURCHASE OF REPLACEMENT PARTS FOR THE SMITH &
LOVELESS, INC. PISTA GRIT SCREW CONVEYOR AT THE BUCK CREEK LIFT
STATION FROM NEWMAN REGENCY GROUP.
WHEREAS, the City of Abilene (City) owns and operates the Hamby Water Reclamation
Facility and the associated lift stations and wastewater collection system as authorized through
TPDES Permit No. WQ0010334004 issued by the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality;
and
WHEREAS, the Buck Creek Lift Station utilizes a Smith & Loveless, Inc. Pista Grit Removal
System to remove sediment and grit from incoming wastewater to protect downstream
equipment at the Buck Creek Lift Station and the Hamby Water Reclamation Facility; and
WHEREAS, the existing grit screw conveyor, which is a critical component of this system, has
failed and requires replacement parts to restore functionality and ensure continued protection of
pumps and mechanical equipment; and
WHEREAS, Newman Regency Group is the sole authorized representative for Smith &
Loveless, Inc. in this region and can supply the necessary replacement parts for the price of
$55,510.77, which are exempt from competitive bidding as sole source procurement; and
NOW THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
ABILENE, TEXAS:
That the City Manager is authorized to purchase replacement parts for the Smith & Loveless,
Inc. Pista Grit Screw Conveyor at the Buck Creek Lift Station from Newman Regency Group for
the price of $55,510.77.
ADOPTED this 10th day of April, 2025.

_____________________________ _____________________________
Shawna Atkinson, City Secretary Weldon Hurt, Mayor
APPROVED:
______________________________
Stanley E. Smith, City Attorney

RESOLUTION NO.
A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF ABILENE, TEXAS
AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER TO ENTER INTO A CONTRACT WITH DAIKEN
APPLIED AMERICA’S, INC. FOR CHILLER REPAIRS AT ABILENE CONVENTION CENTER.
WHEREAS, the City seeks to contract with Daiken Applied America’s, Inc to conduct
repairs on two chillers located at the Abilene Convention Center; and
WHEREAS, Daiken Applied America’s, Inc. is an authorized contractor through contract
#T22010601 of The Inter-Local Purchasing System (TIPS) purchasing co-op, and competitive
bidding is not required.
NOW THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
ABILENE, TEXAS:
Part 1: The City Manager is hereby authorized to enter into a contract with Daiken Applied
America’s, Inc for repair of two chillers located at the Abilene Convention Center in the amount
of $97,666.68.
Part 2: That this Resolution shall take effect immediately from and after passage.
ADOPTED this 8th day of August 2024.

RESOLUTION NO. ________________
A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF ABILENE, TEXAS,
APPROVING THE PURCHASE OF A BAR SCREEN COMPACTOR UNIT FROM
VISION EQUIPMENT FOR THE BUCK CREEK PUMP STATION.
WHEREAS, the City of Abilene (City) owns and operates the Hamby Water Reclamation
Facility and the associated lift stations and wastewater collection system as authorized through
TPDES Permit No. WQ0010334004 issued by the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality;
and
WHEREAS, the Buck Creek Pump Station receives by gravity flow the municipal
wastewater produced by Abilene and certain regional customers, processes it, and pumps it through
a force main uphill to the Hamby Water Reclamation Facility; and
WHEREAS, the Buck Creek Pump Station utilizes coarse bar screens to remove large
suspended solids which are subsequently fed through a compactor unit for dewatering and
compaction before placement in a trailer for subsequent offsite disposal at a solid waste landfill;
and
WHEREAS, Vision Equipment is the manufacturer’s authorized distributor in this region
for the replacement bar screen compactor unit for the Buck Creek Pump Station and can supply
the needed unit for the price $120,500.00; and
NOW THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
ABILENE, TEXAS:
That the City Manager is authorized to purchase the Bar Screen Compactor Unit from
Vision Equipment for the price of $120,500.00.
ADOPTED this 27th day of June, 2024.
